lines.say: [whispering, terrified] Sarge... the Commissar's on our side. Right? Then why is he pointing that at ME?
lines.text: SARGE... THE COMMISSAR'S ON OUR SIDE. RIGHT? THEN WHY IS HE POINTING THAT AT ME?

lines.say: [deadpan] You looked at the exit, son.
lines.text: YOU LOOKED AT THE EXIT, SON.

lines.say: [cold] Fear me more than the enemy, Private. That is my entire job.
lines.text: FEAR ME MORE THAN THE ENEMY, PRIVATE. THAT IS MY ENTIRE JOB.

lines.say: [flat] Officio Prefectus. Every regiment gets one. He can shoot anyone who runs. Even officers.
lines.text: OFFICIO PREFECTUS. EVERY REGIMENT GETS ONE. HE CAN SHOOT ANYONE WHO RUNS. EVEN OFFICERS.

lines.say: [calm, loud] Nobody runs. I am not asking.
lines.text: NOBODY RUNS. I AM NOT ASKING.

lines.say: [flat] Rule two. He goes in first.
lines.text: RULE TWO. HE GOES IN FIRST.

lines.say: [quiet] He's scared of what happens if we run.
lines.text: HE'S SCARED OF WHAT HAPPENS IF WE RUN.

lines.say: [dry, tired] Good lad. I hate writing letters home.
lines.text: GOOD LAD. I HATE WRITING LETTERS HOME.

lines.say: [shaky, relieved] He IS on our side.
[deadpan] Yes. That's why he'd have shot you.
lines.text: YES. THAT'S WHY HE'D HAVE SHOT YOU.
